The '''felguard''' are the [[Legion]]'s basic foot soldiers. They are trained only to fight, so that's about all they do. They operate under the direction of [[Doomguard]], [[Pit Lord]]s and other Legion commanders and generals. Felguard are treated like fodder, driving the Legion's hold on the universe forward like a relentless force of nature.
